name: Moped
description: A motor vehicle on two tandem wheels or three, each over 250 mm, with a seat at least 650 mm high and a motor of 50 cc or less, or an electric motor, that can't take it past 50 km/h; an electric two-wheeler past the e-bike limits that can't exceed 50 km/h lands here.

restrictions.rule: Two tandem wheels or three, each more than 250 mm across, and a seat or saddle at least 650 mm high unladen
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: A gas engine of 50 cc or less or an electric motor of any power, either unable to propel it past 50 km/h
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Driven by pedals, motor or both; pedals aren't required
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Not a motorcycle or power-assisted bicycle
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 5 driver's licence at any stage of graduated licensing; no motorcycle licence
Every rider must wear a helmet meeting the regulations' standards
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 187(1)

restrictions.rule: No passengers on a highway, and nothing carried on the front
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 184(6) and (7)

restrictions.rule: Ridden as close as practicable to the right-hand edge, single file, with at least one hand on the handlebar
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 111

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on a Provincial Trunk Highway with a speed limit over 80 km/h, except to cross it at an intersection
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 185

restrictions.rule: Registered and plated, with the Manitoba Public Insurance premium paid at registration
restrictions.citation: The Drivers and Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. D104, ss. 34, 38(2) and 40(6)
